newsitem.title: USA: Zenith sees significant '97 capital spending.
newsitem.headline: Zenith sees significant '97 capital spending.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp, in its 10-K annual report filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission, said it plans significant capital investment projects in 1997.
It said targeted areas are expansion of color picture tube production capacity, new automated production processes and completion of production lines for computer display tubes.
In 1996, the electronics company said invested $125 million, primarily for equipment and tooling related to product improvements and more efficient production methods.

This was up sharply from the $49 million spending in 1995. Zenith said the level of capital additions in 1996 was higher than the previous year mainly to support expansion and modernization of its Melrose Park, Ill., picture tube plant and its Chihuahua, Mexico, plant for digital set-top boxes.
Glenview, Ill.-based Zenith also outlined terms of its January 1, 1997 contract with Peter Willmott, employed as the company's president and chief executive officer.

Under terms of the agreement, which runs through December 29, 1998, Willmott's annual base salary is $750,000. The executive also will be entitled to a performance bonus based on criteria to be determined by the company.
